description: Nonresident General Big Game/Elk Combination (primary drawing, preference points)
note: FWP preference-point summary as published: 2022 (Total apps 30,947) | 3-2.2 PP 100% Draw (3,651 apps) | 2 PP 97.5% Draw (9,336 apps/ 9,098 combos available) | 0 PP 73.6 % Draw (5,772 apps/4249 combos available). 75% of nonresident combination licenses go to applicants with the most preference points; 25% are drawn at random among applicants with no preference points. Fractional point tiers are party averages. The Big Game Combination includes general deer and elk licenses; the Elk Combination includes the general elk license.
